Includes subdomain URLs in URL map discovery; page has 1 local and 1 subdomain link

```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

let engineConfig = try crawlConfigFromJson("{\"allow_subdomains\":true,\"max_depth\":0,\"respect_robots_txt\":false}")
let engineObj = try createEngine(config: engineConfig)
let url = "https://example.com"
let result = try await Crawlberg.mapUrls(engine: engineObj, url: url)
print(result)
```
